properties.name: spring.datasource.druid.initial-size
properties.description: Initial size of Druid connection pool.

properties.name: spring.datasource.druid.min-idle
properties.description: Minimum number of idle connections in Druid pool.

properties.name: spring.datasource.druid.max-active
properties.description: Maximum number of active connections in Druid pool.

properties.name: spring.datasource.druid.max-wait
properties.description: Maximum wait time in milliseconds to get a connection from Druid pool.

properties.name: logging.level.audit.security
properties.description: Log level for security audit events.

properties.name: logging.level.audit.business
properties.description: Log level for business audit events.

properties.name: logging.level.monitor.performance
properties.description: Log level for performance monitor events.

properties.name: oat.datasource.postgresql.create-database-if-missing
properties.description: Whether to create the configured PostgreSQL database automatically when it is missing.

properties.name: oat.data.path
properties.description: Base file system path for application-managed data.

properties.name: oat.storage.large-payload.path
properties.description: File system path for storing large payload data that exceeds inline threshold.

properties.name: oat.storage.static-source.inline-threshold-bytes
properties.description: Threshold in bytes for storing static source code inline in database versus file system. Data smaller than this threshold is stored inline in DB.

properties.name: ai-platform.base-url
properties.description: Base URL of the standalone AI platform service.

properties.name: ai-platform.connect-timeout-ms
properties.description: Connection timeout for AI platform requests in milliseconds.

properties.name: ai-platform.read-timeout-ms
properties.description: Read timeout for AI platform requests in milliseconds.

properties.name: ai-platform.tenant-id
properties.description: Tenant scope sent to the standalone AI platform.

properties.name: ai-platform.user-id
properties.description: Optional user scope sent to the standalone AI platform.

properties.name: ai-platform.tool-token
properties.description: Token used to authenticate requests to the AI platform service.

properties.name: oat.frontend.base-url
properties.description: Primary frontend origin used for CORS and generated links.

properties.name: oat.frontend.allowed-origins
properties.description: Comma-separated frontend origins allowed by CORS.

properties.name: git.default.username
properties.description: Default username for Git remote operations when request-level credentials are not supplied.

properties.description: Default password or token for Git remote operations when request-level credentials are not supplied.
